<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS peak at m/z 179.0946 as the protonated molecular ion ([M+H]⁺), the neutral mass is ≈178.087 Da. Matching this mass to plausible C/H/O compositions and considering the isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1 intensity, consistent with ~11 carbons), the formula C₁₁H₁₄O₂ fits best (exact neutral mass 178.0994 Da, [M+H]⁺ = 179.1067 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C11H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
